title: Man Causes Complete COMMOTION In His Neighborhood During Arrest
description:
#news #police #arrest 

On October 13, 2022. Officers were on patrol when they recognized a man who had an active warrant 
for fleeing/eluding. When the officers tried to approach him, he immediately fled the scene leading to a pursuit. When the officers got a hold of him, he was less than cooperative with the officers. He was also yelling out racial slurs at the officers. The man was recognized as "Reggie".  This is a video of the events that followed.

THIS VIDEO IS INTENDED TO SHOW THE INTERACTION BETWEEN THE SUSPECT AND THE POLICE

For business inquiries or issues regarding an incident contact:
police101watch@gmail.comn

About us / Disclaimer:

Welcome to Police Watch! We offer an exclusive and authentic look into the world of law enforcement through the lens of body-worn cameras. Our channel provides raw and unfiltered footage of police officers in action, from routine traffic stops to high-stakes situations.

Subscribe to our channel to stay up-to-date on the latest developments in police body camera technology and to gain a deeper understanding of the work that our police officers do every day to keep our communities safe.
